title: Where is his guncase?
html_source: Haines has come armed. The implication is that Ireland is dangerous or he perceives it a threat to him.

anchor.prefix:
He can't make you out. O, my name for you is the best: Kinch, the knifeblade. 

 He shaved warily over his chin. 

 — He was raving all night about a black panther, Stephen said.
anchor.suffix:
— A woful lunatic! Mulligan said. Were you in a funk?
